name: Alex Werner
original_name: アレックス ウェルナー
source:
Alex was sent to Shironagasu Island as a representative.

He is combative to [url=/c95244]Ikeda[/url], as he knows about his background in New York. Although Alex appears to be trying to uncover Shironagasu Island's secrets, he also seems to be harboring several secrets himself.

[From [url=https://tabinomichi.jp/shironagasu/en/]official website[/url]]
